entries.definition: 行李運輸拖車；機場用來載運旅客行李的有輪拖車，通常由牽引車拖動。

explains.en: This low wheeled trailer carries luggage around an airport.
Airport workers load suitcases onto this cart and move them to or from an airplane.
A small powered vehicle can pull this luggage trailer across the airport apron.

examples.en: The worker puts two suitcases on the baggage cart.
examples.zh: 工作人員把兩只行李箱放到行李拖車上。

examples.en: A baggage cart waits beside the airplane.
examples.zh: 一台行李拖車停在飛機旁。

examples.en: The tug pulls a baggage cart across the airport.
examples.zh: 牽引車拖著一台行李拖車穿過機場。

entries.definition: 商務艙；航空客艙中的座位等級，通常提供比經濟艙更寬敞的座位及較多服務。

explains.en: This airline travel class usually offers more space and services than economy class.
Passengers in this cabin often have wider seats and more room for their legs.
This is a premium seating class on an airplane, between economy class and first class when all three are offered.

examples.en: Our business class seats have wide armrests.
examples.zh: 我們的商務艙座位有寬大的扶手。

examples.en: She chooses business class for the long flight.
examples.zh: 她為這趟長途飛行選擇商務艙。

examples.en: The flight attendant serves a meal in business class.

entries.definition: 經濟艙；航空客艙中的一般座位等級，通常座位排列較密集，票價比商務艙低。

explains.en: This is the standard seating class on a passenger airplane.
Seats in this cabin are usually arranged in rows with less space than business class.
This airline travel class usually costs less than business class.

examples.en: Our family sits in economy class.
examples.zh: 我們一家人坐在經濟艙。

examples.en: Economy class has rows of passenger seats.
examples.zh: 經濟艙裡有一排排乘客座位。

examples.en: He watches a film in economy class.
